summary: Frontend-only verification for AzoApp Partner iteration 65 (More sheet redesign + Starter Kit + Rewards + Analytics + Profile & KYC read-only). Login via 'Partner Demo' works. More sheet shows title 'All Menu' + close X + exactly 9 tiles in the required order + pink Logout; Job History & Notifications tiles are correctly absent. All target pages render with expected testIDs, hero/gradients, data from correct backend endpoints, and no console/red-box errors. Starter Kit purchase mock flow was successfully completed (POST /starter-kit/order → mock:true → POST /starter-kit/mock → view switched to starter-kit-owned + kit-tracking). Analytics preset switching (today/7d/30d/90d/month/custom) and custom YYYY-MM-DD refetch GET /api/partner/analytics correctly. Rewards renders hero, auto-payout, 5★ streak (+streak-freeze), next-reward ring, challenges list, and green 'Spotless record' when penalties empty. Profile & KYC renders blue hero + KYC Verified chip + AzoApp Pro chip (activated by kit purchase) + 4.8 rating chip, amber locked notice, and all 5 sections; the onboarding banner correctly hides for approved partner. All 4 doc tiles show 'Not uploaded' as seeded (no bug).
action_items: No functional issues found in this iteration. Feature is ready to ship.

Optional: seed the demo partner registration profile with DOB/gender/email/education and Aadhaar number + doc URLs so QA can visually verify the XXXX XXXX 1234 mask + zoom modal (currently masked value is '—' and all 4 doc tiles show 'Not uploaded' because the seed data has empty fields — the code paths themselves render correctly).
critical_code_review_comments: PartnerStarterKit: order response handling assumes exactly one of free/mock/gateway is truthy — fine for current API but worth a defensive fallback.

PartnerAnalytics custom preset does not client-side validate YYYY-MM-DD before refetching; the query key changes on every keystroke which can spam the backend. Consider debouncing or gating the fetch until both strings match /\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/.
PartnerVerification: mapLink uses `https://www.google.com/maps?q=...` which is fine for web; on native iOS/Android consider `maps:` or `geo:` intents for a better experience.

AppTabBar: navigating to a non-tabs route (e.g. /partner/starter-kit) hides the bottom tab bar entirely, which is expected but means users must use header back — the flow works but is worth confirming with product.
seed_data_creation: None. Reused existing demo partner (+919000000003) and performed one mock Starter Kit purchase on it (as explicitly permitted by the request).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo partner AZP4587602 (Raj Kumar, +919000000003) has already completed the mock Starter Kit purchase in this iteration, so /partner/starter-kit now renders the OWNED view (starter-kit-owned + kit-tracking) and the Profile & KYC hero shows the AzoApp Pro chip. To retest the SALES view of Starter Kit, either reset that partner's kit purchase in the DB or use a fresh partner phone. Auth flow: notifications onboarding screen appears first (tap 'Maybe later') then Login screen (tap 'Partner Demo' one-tap button).
rca_of_issue:
N/A — no bugs found. Test verification details:
- MORE ORDER (verified from DOM): availability, bankkyc, earnings, invoices, incentives, analytics, starterkit, onboarding, support (matches spec exactly).
- STARTER KIT NETWORK: POST /api/starter-kit/order → 200 (mock:true) → POST /api/starter-kit/mock → 200 → GET /api/auth/me → GET /api/starter-kit/me → owned view rendered.
- ANALYTICS NETWORK: preset changes and custom-from/custom-to fills each trigger GET /api/partner/analytics?date_from=&date_to= (verified 3 refetches).
- REWARDS: GET /api/partner/challenges + /api/partner/my-bonuses, all sections render with real data (Fleet rank #1/26, 1 active challenge, streak 0/5, Monthly Superstar closest reward, Spotless record).
- PROFILE: GET /api/partner/registration/profile returns basic info with KYC approved; all 5 sections render; amber locked notice + hero + 4.8 rating chip + AzoApp Pro chip all visible.
